summary.headline: Gulshan Polyols H1 FY27 PAT rose 222% to Rs 92 crore and EBITDA margin hit 12.7%, but management flagged Q3–Q4 margin pressure from record maize prices.
summary.overview: H1 FY27 total income was Rs 1,255 crore (up 11% YoY) and EBITDA Rs 159 crore (up 97%), with EBITDA margin at 12.7% versus 7.1% a year earlier. Q2 total income was about Rs 714 crore (up 13%) with EBITDA of Rs 69 crore (up 63%) and PAT of Rs 39 crore (up 151%). Management said FY27 guidance is unchanged, but warned that record maize prices (Rs 30-32/kg) will pressure margins in Q3 and Q4 by an estimated 1-2 percentage points. The company is shifting feedstock toward FCI rice and damaged food grains (DFG) and announced sorbitol, MDP/NDC and green hydrogen projects.

financial_highlights.change: vs Rs 112 crore at end FY26 (as stated in call)

financial_highlights.metric: H1 FY27 cash flow from operations

segments.name: Ethanol (Q2 FY27)
segments.commentary: Revenue Rs 427 crore with EBITDA Rs 62.5 crore and margin 14.6%, versus 8.5% in the year-ago quarter. Allocation of 19.7 crore litres gives an order book of about Rs 1,300 crore, plus about Rs 300 crore from by-products.

segments.name: Grain processing (Q2 FY27)
segments.commentary: Revenue Rs 166 crore (up 24% YoY), but EBITDA fell to about Rs 2.5 crore from Rs 3.7 crore, with margin at 1.45% versus 2.8%. Management expects further margin pressure in Q3 and Q4.

segments.name: Mineral chemicals (Q2 FY27)
segments.commentary: Revenue Rs 22.7 crore (vs Rs 21.9 crore) with EBITDA Rs 4.6 crore and margin 20.2%.

segments.name: Green chemicals (sorbitol, MDP)
segments.commentary: Two Mathura expansions are planned: a 30,000 MT sorbitol plant in Uttar Pradesh (total 110,000 MT) and MDP/NDC capacity raised from 5,000 MT to 30,000 MT. Combined capex is Rs 100-120 crore, with commissioning targeted for May 2027.

guidance_outlook: FY27 consolidated revenue target of about Rs 2,600 crore: ethanol Rs 1,700-1,800 crore, grain processing about Rs 800 crore, mineral chemicals about Rs 100 crore.
FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin of about 10% and PAT margin of about 5%, both stated as unchanged.
Management expects grain-processing margin to fall 1-2 percentage points in Q3 and Q4 but aims to stay around 9-11% at the consolidated level.
FY28 consolidated revenue target of Rs 2,800-3,000 crore, with Rs 3,000 crore described as achievable subject to execution.
New sorbitol/MDP-NDC capacity expected to generate Rs 200-250 crore revenue at about 10-11% EBITDA margin at optimal utilisation, with Rs 120-130 crore in the first year and a 2-3 year ramp-up.
PCC plant in Punjab (22,000 MT) expected to add about Rs 20 crore revenue a year from FY28, commissioning April 2027.
Green hydrogen deal with ZFI (6 MW, build-own-operate, 10-year contract worth Rs 300 crore) is expected to cut hydrogen cost by about 20% and reduce emissions by about 15,000 tonnes a year.
capex_capacity: Sorbitol: new 30,000 MT/yr plant in Uttar Pradesh (Mathura) takes total capacity to 110,000 MT/yr; existing plant is in Gujarat.
MDP/NDC: capacity expanded from 5,000 MT to 30,000 MT/yr in a flexible plant that can make either product; management indicated about 20,000 MT MDP and 10,000 MT NDC, subject to demand.
PCC plant (22,000 MT/yr) in Punjab, commissioning targeted April 2027.
Combined expansion capex of Rs 100-120 crore: about Rs 100 crore bank debt and Rs 20 crore internal accruals. Bank sanction expected in two to three quarters.
Ethanol capacity expected to reach about 22 crore litres in FY27, with de-bottlenecking aimed at 24-25 crore litres.
Capital subsidy of Rs 5 crore received from Assam, booked against capital work-in-progress rather than P&L.
Capital work-in-progress of about Rs 15 crore across Mathura, Gujarat and Bharuch sites.
demand_pricing: Feedstock mix on current OMC allocation: about 25% FCI rice, 10% damaged food grains (DFG) and the balance maize. OMCs allow switching between feedstocks.
Open-market maize at Rs 30-32/kg, the highest ever; management expects elevated maize prices for the next 2-3 months and is lobbying for lower import duty.
Management says maize-based ethanol becomes unviable above about Rs 26/kg maize price; DFG and FCI rice remain viable.
Ethanol EBITDA margin guided at about 10% for the current quarter (management only gave EBITDA, not gross margin).
Country liquor order of about Rs 100 crore for FY27 offers better margins, but the allocation is annual and limited.
Inventory rose about Rs 60 crore QoQ as management pre-bought grain ahead of expected price rises.
NDC sells at about Rs 150/kg versus about Rs 50/kg for MDP, per management.

qa_highlights.question: What is the current feedstock mix and how much of the shift to FCI rice and DFG has been implemented?
qa_highlights.answer: The allocation is about 25% FCI rice, 10% DFG and the rest maize. The mix can be changed with OMCs, switching takes 2-3 hours, and management plans to move further away from maize while prices stay high.

qa_highlights.question: Will Q3 margins be pressured given elevated commodity prices?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects pressure on Q3 margins but said H1 results give a cushion and it hopes to meet full-year guidance.

qa_highlights.question: What are the revenue and EBITDA potential and funding for the Mathura expansion?
qa_highlights.answer: Peak revenue is about Rs 250 crore at about 10-11% EBITDA margin. Funding is about Rs 100 crore bank debt and Rs 20 crore internal accruals, with a 2-3 year ramp-up.

qa_highlights.question: What is the inventory build and will it normalise in H2?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said inventory rose because grain was bought in advance to protect against further price increases, and raw-material stock is being used for future processing.

qa_highlights.question: Will grain-processing margins hold, and what is the expected range?
qa_highlights.answer: Margins will be hit in Q3 and Q4 by about 1-2 percentage points. Management is aiming for 9-11% at the consolidated level, versus about 10% last year.

qa_highlights.question: What is the debt position and repayment plan?
qa_highlights.answer: Long-term debt is about Rs 123 crore across two banks. The SBI and SIDBI installments are being repaid, with SIDBI fully repaid by February. Total debt is about Rs 233 crore including working capital. Management aims for about Rs 200 crore long-term debt by March 2027 after drawing the new Rs 100 crore loan.

risks_watch: Maize prices at record highs (Rs 30-32/kg) and Q3–Q4 grain-processing margin compression of 1-2 percentage points.
Import-duty relief on maize is uncertain; El Nino has affected crops and management expects high prices for 2-3 months.
Working capital: inventory rose about Rs 60 crore QoQ and total debt rose to about Rs 233 crore, though operating cash flow of Rs 119 crore is helping repayments.
Execution of the sorbitol, MDP/NDC and PCC projects by April–May 2027 and the bank sanction for Rs 100 crore.
Green hydrogen plant (ZFI, 6 MW) commissioning timeline and the realised hydrogen cost saving.
Demand absorption for new sorbitol and MDP/NDC capacity given ramp-up of 2-3 years.
summary.management_tone: Confident on H1 delivery and on reaffirming FY27 and FY28 targets, but cautious on near-term margins, with management openly flagging Q3–Q4 pressure from maize prices. Responses on procurement and pricing were specific, while some answers on debt and the ethanol margin were loosely stated or evasive.
key_quotes: Importantly, our full-year FI27 guidance remains unchanged.

The performance delivered during the first half gives us confidence in our ability to navigate the current operating environment and remain on track to deliver our previously communicated commitments.
We believe that 3,000 crores revenue milestone is achievable subject to execution and prevailing market conditions.
We are the first company who's setting up this kind of on-site green hydrogen plant.

adds.what: 30,000 MT/yr sorbitol plant in Uttar Pradesh (Mathura), total sorbitol capacity to 110,000 MT/yr
MDP/NDC capacity expansion from 5,000 MT to 30,000 MT/yr (flexible plant, Mathura)
Ethanol capacity to reach about 22 crore litres in FY27, with de-bottlenecking aimed at 24-25 crore litres

growth.why: FY27 consolidated revenue ~Rs 2,600 crore and 10% EBITDA margin held, with H1 revenue up 11% and Q2 up 13%; ethanol order book (~Rs 1,300 crore) and new sorbitol/MDP/PCC capacity support it, but Q3-Q4 grain margin pressure of 1-2 points from maize prices is a risk and FY28 target of Rs 2,800-3,000 crore is new.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Management flagged grain-processing margin falling 1-2 pts in Q3 and Q4 from record maize at Rs 30-32/kg, with consolidated EBITDA guided to hold around 9-11% versus H1 at 12.7%; grain EBITDA margin already down to 1.45% from 2.8%.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Sorbitol (30,000 MT Mathura), MDP/NDC (5,000 to 30,000 MT) and 22,000 MT Punjab PCC plant are under construction with commissioning targeted April-May 2027; ethanol capacity to about 22 crore litres in FY27.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Ethanol order book about Rs 1,300 crore on 19.7 crore litre allocation, H1 total income up 11% and Q2 up 13%; FY27 revenue target about Rs 2,600 crore and FY28 Rs 2,800-3,000 crore.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Rs 100-120 crore expansion capex is already committed with Rs 100 crore bank sanction expected in two to three quarters; no fresh capex beyond these was guided, and utilisation was not disclosed.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: FY27 revenue (about Rs 2,600 crore) and 10% EBITDA margin were only held, not raised, with Q3-Q4 margin pressure flagged from maize prices.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Management says margins will be hit 1-2 pts in Q3-Q4 and maize-based ethanol becomes unviable above Rs 26/kg while maize is at Rs 30-32/kg, though H1 cushion is said to support the full-year 10% margin.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Sorbitol, MDP/NDC and PCC capacity with commissioning April-May 2027; sorbitol/MDP-NDC expected to add Rs 120-130 crore in the first year, and NDC sells at about Rs 150/kg versus Rs 50/kg for MDP.

rows.label: Feedstock shift to FCI rice and DFG
rows.why: Current mix is 25% FCI rice and 10% DFG with the rest maize, and management plans to move further away from maize while prices stay high at Rs 30-32/kg.

rows.label: Ethanol margin recovery
rows.why: Ethanol EBITDA margin rose to 14.6% in Q2 from 8.5%, with about 10% guided for the current quarter, so the gain is partly expected to reverse.

rows.label: Long-term debt to about Rs 200 crore by March 2027
rows.why: Long-term debt is about Rs 123 crore, total debt about Rs 233 crore, H1 operating cash flow Rs 119 crore, and SIDBI fully repaid by February after the new Rs 100 crore loan is drawn.

tone.note: Management was confident on H1 delivery and on reaffirming FY27 and FY28 targets, but cautious on Q3-Q4 margins from maize prices; analysts pressed on margins, the ethanol margin, debt and the inventory build.
